items.title: Dysfunction of the blood-brain barrier and neurovascular unit in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - From advanced human models to treatments.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, resulting in progressive and eventually complete loss of motor function. The phenotypical heterogeneity of ALS poses a challenge to early diagnosis and treatment, with currently available therapeutics only capable of relieving symptoms and slowing progression. While ALS is classified as a motor neuron disease (MND), research has identified significant impairment to the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurovascular unit (NVU) of ALS patients. The BBB along with supporting cells of the NVU selectively control the entry of substances into the central nervous system (CNS) and maintain brain homeostasis, with its many cellular components demonstrating impaired function, specifically relating to inflammation, oxidative stress and TDP-43 proteinopathy. The advent of more advanced in vitro techniques as well as use of patient-derived BBB cells has presented a promising alternative to recreate the in vivo structure of the BBB/NVU in a highly controlled platform. Such approaches have ranged from simple 2-dimensional (2D) cell culture to intricate 3-dimensional (3D) co-culture systems, as well as microfluidic systems and organoids, with a potential to investigate ALS associated BBB/NVU dysfunction and drug discovery. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of known BBB/NVU dysfunction in ALS and methods of investigating this using in vitro and in vivo platforms with a focus on inflammation, oxidative stress and pathological TDP-43 expression. This review also presents a future perspective to overcoming barriers to treatment of ALS using new patient-derived BBB/NVU model systems.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中血脑屏障与神经血管单元的功能障碍——从先进人类模型到治疗
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS中血脑屏障和神经血管单元的功能障碍，重点涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变。文章还总结了从2D培养到3D共培养、微流控和类器官等体外模型，以及患者来源BBB细胞在模拟ALS病理和药物筛选中的应用前景。
items.insight: 该综述将ALS的病理视角从单纯运动神经元扩展到血脑屏障和神经血管单元，并系统整理了患者来源细胞、3D共培养、微流控和类器官等先进人类模型。对ALS研究者而言，这有助于理解BBB/NVU功能障碍在疾病中的角色，并为开发更贴近人类生理的药物筛选平台提供方法学参考。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS中存在血脑屏障和神经血管单元功能障碍，涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变；患者来源的2D、3D、微流控和类器官模型可用于研究这些改变并支持药物发现。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据；所讨论的体外模型在重现体内BBB/NVU复杂结构方面仍存在局限。
aiRead.watchNext: 患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统的进一步开发及其在ALS药物筛选和转化研究中的应用验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性为特征，导致运动功能进行性且最终完全丧失。ALS的表型异质性给早期诊断和治疗带来挑战，目前可用的治疗手段仅能缓解症状并延缓进展。尽管ALS被归类为运动神经元病（MND），研究已发现ALS患者的血脑屏障（BBB）和神经血管单元（NVU）存在显著损伤。BBB与NVU的支持细胞选择性控制物质进入中枢神经系统（CNS）并维持脑稳态，其多种细胞组分表现出功能受损，尤其涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变。更先进的体外技术以及患者来源BBB细胞的应用，为在高度可控平台上重建BBB/NVU的体内结构提供了有前景的替代方案。此类方法从简单的二维（2D）细胞培养到复杂的三维（3D）共培养系统，以及微流控系统和类器官，具有研究ALS相关BBB/NVU功能障碍和药物发现的潜力。本综述全面评估了ALS中已知的BBB/NVU功能障碍，以及利用体外和体内平台研究这一问题的方法，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和病理性TDP-43表达。本综述还提出了利用新的患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统克服ALS治疗障碍的未来展望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦ALS中血脑屏障与神经血管单元功能障碍这一新近受关注领域，并强调患者来源先进人类模型在机制研究和药物发现中的转化价值。

items.title: Microbiota-derived metabolite-GPCR signalling in neurodegeneration.
items.summary: The gut microbiome acts as a primary regulator of host homeostasis, influencing the entire body through bidirectional communication along the gut-brain axis (GBA). Dysbiosis, which is defined as a state of microbial imbalance involving alterations in community composition and function, can disrupt the synthesis of important microbiota-derived metabolites, such as short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), bile acids and neurotransmitter precursors. This can lead to impaired essential host signalling pathways. There is growing evidence that metabolic alterations associated with dysbiosis contribute to the onset and progression of neurodegenerative disorders (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), Huntington's disease (HD), multiple sclerosis (MS) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). In this context, G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) act as essential molecular transducers that link microbial metabolites to intracellular signalling networks. Aberrant GPCR activation, driven by altered metabolite profiles, modulates key downstream pathways including cAMP, MAPK, PI3K/Akt, NF-κB and Ca2 + signalling. This promotes neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction and pathological protein aggregation - hallmark processes underlying neurodegeneration. By identifying convergent and disease-specific signalling pathways, the review highlights mechanistic nodes of therapeutic relevance and discusses GPCR-centric emerging and other microbiome-targeted strategies aimed at restoring metabolic and signalling homeostasis in neurodegenerative disorders.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中微生物群衍生代谢物-GPCR信号传导
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了肠道菌群失调如何通过改变短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质前体等代谢物，影响G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）信号，进而经cAMP、MAPK、PI3K/Akt、NF-κB和钙信号等通路促进神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和蛋白聚集，参与包括ALS在内的多种神经退行性疾病。文章还讨论了以GPCR为靶点、恢复代谢与信号稳态的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 该综述将肠道微生物代谢物与GPCR信号直接联系起来，为ALS等神经退行性疾病提供了肠-脑轴机制框架。它提示GPCR可能是连接环境因素（菌群）与神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍等ALS核心病理的分子节点，有助于研究者寻找可干预的代谢-信号通路，并推动微生物组靶向策略向机制驱动的治疗开发转化。

aiRead.keyFinding: 菌群失调导致的代谢物改变可通过异常GPCR信号激活cAMP、MAPK、PI3K/Akt、NF-κB和钙信号等通路，促进神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和蛋白聚集，参与ALS等神经退行性疾病。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据或临床试验结果，所提出的机制关联和GPCR靶向策略仍需实验验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对特定微生物代谢物-GPCR轴在ALS模型中的功能验证，以及以GPCR为靶点的微生物组干预策略的临床前和早期临床研究。

items.abstractZh: 肠道微生物组是宿主稳态的主要调节者，通过肠-脑轴（GBA）的双向通讯影响全身。菌群失调被定义为涉及群落组成和功能改变的微生物失衡状态，可破坏重要微生物群衍生代谢物的合成，如短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）、胆汁酸和神经递质前体。这可能导致宿主必需信号通路受损。越来越多的证据表明，与菌群失调相关的代谢改变促进神经退行性疾病（NDDs）的发生和进展，包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、亨廷顿病（HD）、多发性硬化（MS）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）。在此背景下，G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）作为连接微生物代谢物与细胞内信号网络的重要分子转导器。由代谢物谱改变驱动的异常GPCR激活调节关键下游通路，包括cAMP、MAPK、PI3K/Akt、NF-κB和Ca2+信号传导。这促进神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和病理性蛋白聚集——神经退行性变的标志性过程。通过识别趋同和疾病特异性信号通路，本综述强调了具有治疗相关性的机制节点，并讨论了以GPCR为中心的新兴及其他微生物组靶向策略，旨在恢复神经退行性疾病中的代谢和信号稳态。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了微生物群衍生代谢物通过GPCR信号驱动神经退行性变的机制，并明确将ALS纳入讨论，为肠-脑轴靶向治疗提供了转化线索。

items.title: The thymus gland is a target and maintainer of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathophysiology.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by the selective loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord with evidence of local neuroinflammation. Regulatory T cells (Treg) exert neuroprotective effects and correlate with disease progression, but central mechanisms governing Treg development during ALS remain unclear. We investigated the thymic architecture and T cell differentiation in SOD1-G93A (mSOD1) ALS mice at multiple disease stages. Thymocyte and thymic epithelial cells (TEC) subpopulations, as well as stages of Treg differentiation and suppressive capacity, were analyzed by flow cytometry, in situ immunofluorescence, and functional assays. At late disease stage (120 days-old), mSOD1 mice displayed thymic atrophy, reduced thymocyte numbers, and decreased double-positive (DP), CD4 single-positive (SP), and Treg populations. Foxp3 expression per cell was preserved, but Treg progenitors and mature Treg numbers declined, paralleled by reduced suppressive function in vitro . TEC analysis revealed reduced total and mature medullary TEC (CD80 high MHCII high ), despite preserved Aire expression. Foxp3 + cells were abnormally localized at cortical sites, away from mTEC, associated with migratory abnormalities and increased apoptosis. TREC evaluation revealed reduced intrathymic sjTREC, consistent with impaired proliferation and differentiation between DN and DP stages, although peripheral sj/βTREC ratios remained stable. Reduced Treg numbers were also observed in lymph nodes draining affected hindlimbs. Our findings identify the thymus as a target organ in ALS, where thymic involution, TEC loss, and Treg dysfunction may compromise immune tolerance. These alterations likely reinforce the role of the thymus in peripheral immune dysregulation and neuroinflammation observed in ALS.
items.titleZh: 胸腺是肌萎缩侧索硬化病理生理学的靶标和维持者
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现，疾病晚期胸腺出现萎缩，胸腺细胞和调节性T细胞（Treg）数量减少，胸腺上皮细胞（尤其是成熟髓质TEC）丢失，Treg抑制功能下降，且Foxp3+细胞在皮质区异常定位。这些变化提示胸腺是ALS的靶器官，其功能紊乱可能加剧外周免疫失调和神经炎症。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS的免疫失调机制从外周前移到中枢免疫器官胸腺，揭示了胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg发育/功能缺陷在疾病晚期的作用。对于ALS研究者而言，它提示胸腺可能是干预免疫耐受、延缓神经炎症的新靶点，并强调了在SOD1模型之外验证胸腺变化的重要性。

aiRead.keyFinding: 在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠疾病晚期，胸腺萎缩、胸腺上皮细胞丢失、Treg数量减少和功能受损，提示胸腺是ALS的靶器官并参与外周免疫失调。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1-G93A小鼠模型，尚未在人类ALS患者中验证；机制因果关系和胸腺变化对疾病进程的贡献仍需进一步研究。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究可关注在人类ALS中胸腺结构和Treg发育的变化，以及靶向胸腺或Treg通路能否改善疾病结局。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是脑和脊髓中运动神经元的选择性丢失，并伴有局部神经炎症的证据。调节性T细胞（Treg）发挥神经保护作用并与疾病进展相关，但ALS中调控Treg发育的中枢机制仍不清楚。我们在多个疾病阶段研究了SOD1-G93A（mSOD1）ALS小鼠的胸腺结构和T细胞分化。通过流式细胞术、原位免疫荧光和功能实验分析了胸腺细胞和胸腺上皮细胞（TEC）亚群，以及Treg分化的各个阶段和抑制能力。在疾病晚期（120日龄），mSOD1小鼠表现出胸腺萎缩、胸腺细胞数量减少，以及双阳性（DP）、CD4单阳性（SP）和Treg群体减少。每个细胞的Foxp3表达得以保留，但Treg祖细胞和成熟Treg数量下降，同时体外抑制功能降低。TEC分析显示总TEC和成熟髓质TEC（CD80高MHCII高）减少，尽管Aire表达得以保留。Foxp3+细胞异常定位于皮质区域，远离mTEC，与迁移异常和凋亡增加相关。TREC评估显示胸腺内sjTREC减少，与DN和DP阶段之间的增殖和分化受损一致，尽管外周sj/βTREC比值保持稳定。在引流受累后肢的淋巴结中也观察到Treg数量减少。我们的发现确定胸腺是ALS的靶器官，其中胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg功能障碍可能损害免疫耐受。这些改变可能强化了胸腺在ALS中观察到的外周免疫失调和神经炎症中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了胸腺作为ALS免疫失调的中枢靶器官，为理解Treg功能障碍和神经炎症提供了转化潜力。

items.title: Exploring the toxicological impact of BDE-209 on neurodegenerative diseases through network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and in-vitro study.
items.summary: Decabromodiphenyl ether (BDE-209) is a persistent flame retardant associated with neurotoxicity, but its potential links to neurodegenerative diseases remain unclear. We integrated network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and in vitro experiments to investigate BDE-209 in Parkinson's disease (PD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Network analysis identified 90 shared targets, enriched in lipid metabolism, oxidative stress, and inflammatory pathways, including IL-17 and TNF signaling. Docking prioritized the FKBP12-mTOR complex as a candidate binding system, with a score of -8.6 kcal/mol. MD simulations supported the stability of the predicted pose, which was dominated by van der Waals and hydrophobic interactions involving PHE-128 and TRP-190. In differentiated PC12 cells, BDE-209 increased p-mTOR at 10 μM and IL-1β at 20 μM without overt cytotoxicity. Rapamycin attenuated the p-mTOR response, supporting mTOR involvement, although mTOR dependence of IL-1β induction was not established. At 40 μM, BDE-209 reduced viability, potentially confounded by precipitation or aggregation. These findings implicate mTOR dysregulation in BDE-209 cellular responses, but direct binding, chronic exposure, and in vivo disease relevance require further validation.
items.titleZh: 通过网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外研究探索BDE-209对神经退行性疾病的毒理学影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究结合网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和PC12细胞实验，探索持久性阻燃剂BDE-209与帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化的潜在关联。分析发现90个共享靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路；FKBP12-mTOR复合物被预测为候选结合系统。细胞实验中，BDE-209在10 μM增加p-mTOR，20 μM增加IL-1β，40 μM降低细胞活力。研究提示mTOR失调可能参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性尚未验证。
items.insight: 该研究将环境毒理学与ALS等神经退行性疾病联系起来，提出BDE-209可能通过mTOR信号通路影响神经退行性过程。对于ALS研究者而言，这提示环境暴露因素可能作为疾病修饰因子值得关注，尤其是mTOR通路在ALS中已有一定研究基础。但当前证据仅限于计算预测和PC12细胞模型，尚未在ALS模型或患者中验证，因此应视为假说生成而非机制确证。

aiRead.keyFinding: BDE-209在PC12细胞中增加p-mTOR和IL-1β，网络分析提示其与ALS等神经退行性疾病共享mTOR、炎症和氧化应激相关靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 仅使用PC12细胞和计算模拟，无ALS模型或体内验证；40 μM浓度下细胞活力下降可能受沉淀或聚集混杂；IL-1β诱导是否依赖mTOR未确立。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续需在ALS细胞或动物模型中验证BDE-209的慢性暴露效应、直接靶点结合及mTOR依赖性，并评估人群环境暴露与ALS风险的流行病学关联。

items.abstractZh: 十溴二苯醚（BDE-209）是一种与神经毒性相关的持久性阻燃剂，但其与神经退行性疾病的潜在联系仍不清楚。我们整合了网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟和体外实验，研究BDE-209在帕金森病（PD）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的作用。网络分析识别出90个共享靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路，包括IL-17和TNF信号通路。对接分析将FKBP12-mTOR复合物优先列为候选结合系统，评分为-8.6 kcal/mol。MD模拟支持预测构象的稳定性，该构象主要由涉及PHE-128和TRP-190的范德华力和疏水相互作用主导。在分化的PC12细胞中，BDE-209在10 μM时增加p-mTOR，在20 μM时增加IL-1β，且无明显细胞毒性。雷帕霉素减弱了p-mTOR反应，支持mTOR参与其中，但IL-1β诱导对mTOR的依赖性尚未确立。在40 μM时，BDE-209降低细胞活力，可能受到沉淀或聚集的混杂影响。这些发现提示mTOR失调参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性仍需进一步验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近整合网络毒理学与体外实验，提示持久性环境污染物BDE-209可能通过mTOR通路与ALS等神经退行性疾病相关，具有环境-基因互作转化研究价值。

items.title: Mdivi-1 regulates mitochondrial fission and function via the CaMK2/Drp1 pathway in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease involving progressive motor neuron loss. Given the high energy reliance of motor neurons, mitochondrial dysfunction especially excessive fission critically contributes to disease pathogenesis. Mitochondrial division inhibitor-1 (Mdivi-1), an inhibitor of the fission protein Drp1, has shown neuroprotective potential, but its mechanism of action on mitochondrial quality control in ALS remains unclear. Here, we examined the effects of Mdivi-1 on mitochondrial dysfunction and cell injury in NSC34 cells expressing mutant SOD1^G93A and in SOD1^G93A transgenic mice. ALS models exhibited increased reactive oxygen species accumulation, reduced mitochondrial content, loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, enhanced apoptotic signaling, and increased phosphorylation of CaMK2 and Drp1. Mdivi-1 treatment improved cell viability, reduced oxidative stress, restored mitochondrial integrity and membrane potential, and suppressed apoptosis. In addition, Mdivi-1 decreased Drp1 phosphorylation, whereas co-treatment with the CaMK2 activator DCP-LA partially reversed these effects. Furthermore, direct inhibition of CaMK2 with KN93 reduced CaMK2 and Drp1 phosphorylation, providing additional evidence that CaMK2 regulates Drp1 activation in SOD1^G93A cells. These findings indicate that pharmacological modulation of the CaMK2/Drp1 pathway can attenuate aberrant mitochondrial fission and associated cellular dysfunction in ALS models.
items.titleZh: Mdivi-1通过CaMK2/Drp1通路调控肌萎缩侧索硬化中的线粒体分裂与功能
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1^G93A ALS细胞和小鼠模型中证实，线粒体分裂抑制剂Mdivi-1可改善细胞活力、减少氧化应激、恢复线粒体功能并抑制凋亡。机制上，Mdivi-1通过降低CaMK2和Drp1磷酸化发挥作用，而CaMK2激活剂可部分逆转其效应，直接抑制CaMK2也减少Drp1磷酸化，提示CaMK2/Drp1通路是ALS中线粒体过度分裂的关键调控轴。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS中线粒体过度分裂的机制具体化为CaMK2/Drp1信号轴，并提供了药理学干预（Mdivi-1）在细胞和小鼠模型中的验证。对于关注线粒体质量控制、SOD1相关ALS机制及潜在靶点验证的研究者，该通路值得进一步在更多ALS模型和临床前毒理学中跟踪。

aiRead.studyType: 动物与细胞实验（SOD1^G93A NSC34细胞及SOD1^G93A转基因小鼠）
aiRead.keyFinding: Mdivi-1通过抑制CaMK2/Drp1通路减轻ALS模型中的异常线粒体分裂、氧化应激和凋亡，改善线粒体功能与细胞活力。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1^G93A模型，未涵盖其他ALS遗传亚型或散发性ALS；Mdivi-1的体内疗效、血脑屏障穿透性及长期安全性尚未充分评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续需在多种ALS模型（如TDP-43、C9orf72）中验证CaMK2/Drp1通路的普适性，并推进Mdivi-1或靶向该通路的候选药物在临床前毒理和药代动力学中的评估。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种涉及进行性运动神经元丢失的致死性神经退行性疾病。鉴于运动神经元对能量的高度依赖，线粒体功能障碍尤其是过度分裂在疾病发病机制中起关键作用。线粒体分裂抑制剂-1（Mdivi-1）是分裂蛋白Drp1的抑制剂，已显示出神经保护潜力，但其在ALS中对线粒体质量控制的作用机制仍不清楚。本研究检测了Mdivi-1对表达突变型SOD1^G93A的NSC34细胞及SOD1^G93A转基因小鼠中线粒体功能障碍和细胞损伤的影响。ALS模型表现出活性氧积累增加、线粒体含量减少、线粒体膜电位丢失、凋亡信号增强以及CaMK2和Drp1磷酸化增加。Mdivi-1处理改善了细胞活力，减少了氧化应激，恢复了线粒体完整性和膜电位，并抑制了凋亡。此外，Mdivi-1降低了Drp1磷酸化，而与CaMK2激活剂DCP-LA共处理部分逆转了这些效应。进一步，用KN93直接抑制CaMK2降低了CaMK2和Drp1磷酸化，提供了CaMK2在SOD1^G93A细胞中调控Drp1激活的额外证据。这些发现表明，药理学调控CaMK2/Drp1通路可减轻ALS模型中的异常线粒体分裂及相关细胞功能障碍。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了CaMK2/Drp1通路在SOD1^G93A ALS模型中调控线粒体分裂的具体机制，为靶向线粒体质量控制提供了可转化的临床前证据。

items.title: Nitrate-responsive Sialin2 couples stress granule assembly and clearance to maintain neuronal homeostasis.
items.summary: Stress granules (SGs) are phase-separated ribonucleoprotein condensates that support cellular adaptation to acute stress, but how extracellular signals coordinate their assembly and recovery-phase clearance remains unclear. Here, we show that nitrate-responsive Sialin2 coordinates SG homeostasis across the stress cycle. During acute stress, Sialin2 undergoes liquid-liquid phase separation and co-assembles with Ras GTPase-activating protein SH3-domain-binding protein (G3BP)-centered scaffolds to promote SG formation. During recovery, Sialin2 preserves liquid-like SG dynamics and promotes autophagy-linked clearance. Sialin2 loss delays SG resolution, promotes retention of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)-linked fused in sarcoma (FUS) and TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) variants, and enhances amyloid precursor protein (APP)-related amyloidogenic output. In an ALS mouse model, nitrate treatment reduces SG-like pathology and neuroinflammation, preserves neuronal integrity, and delays functional decline. Together, these findings define a nitrate-Sialin2 signaling module that couples SG assembly to recovery-phase clearance and links inorganic anion sensing to protection against neurodegeneration.
items.titleZh: 硝酸盐响应性Sialin2偶联应激颗粒组装与清除以维持神经元稳态
items.summaryZh: 该研究发现硝酸盐响应蛋白Sialin2在应激颗粒形成和清除中起关键协调作用。急性应激时，Sialin2通过液-液相分离与G3BP共组装促进应激颗粒形成；恢复期则维持应激颗粒液态动态并促进自噬清除。Sialin2缺失会延迟应激颗粒消散，导致ALS相关FUS和TDP-43变体滞留，并增加APP淀粉样生成。在ALS小鼠模型中，硝酸盐治疗可减少应激颗粒样病理和神经炎症，保护神经元，延缓功能衰退。
items.insight: 该研究将无机阴离子感知、应激颗粒动力学与ALS相关蛋白稳态联系起来，提出了硝酸盐-Sialin2信号模块作为应激颗粒组装与清除的协调者。其动物模型结果提示硝酸盐干预可能通过改善应激颗粒病理和神经炎症延缓ALS进展，为ALS治疗提供了新的潜在靶点和干预策略，值得进一步验证其临床转化价值。

aiRead.studyType: 基础研究（细胞与动物实验）
aiRead.keyFinding: 硝酸盐响应性Sialin2通过液-液相分离协调应激颗粒组装与恢复期自噬清除，其缺失导致ALS相关FUS/TDP-43变体滞留；硝酸盐治疗在ALS小鼠模型中减轻病理并延缓功能衰退。
aiRead.limitation: 研究主要基于细胞和动物模型，尚未在人类ALS患者中验证Sialin2通路和硝酸盐治疗的安全性与有效性；具体分子机制和硝酸盐的最佳干预方案仍需进一步探索。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注Sialin2在人类ALS组织中的表达与功能变化，以及硝酸盐或相关调节剂在临床试验中的转化研究，特别是针对应激颗粒病理和TDP-43/FUS蛋白稳态的干预效果。

items.abstractZh: 应激颗粒（SGs）是相分离的核糖核蛋白凝聚体，支持细胞对急性应激的适应，但细胞外信号如何协调其组装与恢复期清除仍不清楚。在此，我们发现硝酸盐响应性Sialin2在整个应激周期中协调SG稳态。在急性应激期间，Sialin2发生液-液相分离，并与以Ras GTP酶激活蛋白SH3结构域结合蛋白（G3BP）为中心的支架共组装，促进SG形成。在恢复期，Sialin2维持液态样SG动态并促进自噬相关清除。Sialin2缺失延迟SG消散，促进ALS相关融合肉瘤（FUS）和TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）变体的滞留，并增强淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）相关的淀粉样生成输出。在ALS小鼠模型中，硝酸盐治疗减少SG样病理和神经炎症，保护神经元完整性，并延缓功能衰退。总之，这些发现定义了一个硝酸盐-Sialin2信号模块，将SG组装与恢复期清除偶联，并将无机阴离子感知与神经退行性变的保护联系起来。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了硝酸盐-Sialin2信号模块在应激颗粒组装与清除中的双重调控作用，并直接在ALS小鼠模型中验证了硝酸盐治疗的保护效果，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化潜力。

items.title: From patient cells to patient therapy: Twenty years of iPSC-based translation in neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Twenty years after the discovery of induced pluripotent stem cells, the field has progressed from patient-specific disease modeling toward cell-based therapies for neurodegenerative disorders. Parkinson's disease has emerged as the leading model for neuronal replacement, whereas Huntington's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis require distinct combinations of circuit reconstruction, cellular support, immune modulation, and engineered therapeutic delivery. We discuss key determinants of clinical translation, including cell source, product identity, graft composition, graft-host interactions, manufacturing reproducibility, genomic integrity, and clinical evaluation. We propose that the interval between cell transplantation and long-term engraftment constitutes a biological "black box" in which graft fate and therapeutic outcome are determined. As regenerative medicine enters its third decade, future progress will depend not only on generating therapeutic cells but also on elucidating and engineering the biological processes that determine their fate after transplantation, marking a conceptual transition from stem cell biology toward transplantation biology.
items.titleZh: 从患者细胞到患者治疗：诱导多能干细胞在神经退行性疾病中二十年的转化历程
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述回顾了诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）在神经退行性疾病中二十年的转化研究。文章指出，帕金森病是神经元替代治疗的主要模型，而ALS等疾病需要更复杂的策略，包括回路重建、细胞支持、免疫调节和工程化递送。作者强调，细胞移植后到长期植入之间的“黑箱”期是决定移植物命运和治疗效果的关键，未来需从干细胞生物学转向移植生物学。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了iPSC细胞治疗转化的系统性框架，特别强调了移植后“黑箱”期的重要性，提示未来研究需关注移植物与宿主微环境的相互作用、免疫调节及工程化改造，而非仅聚焦于细胞生成。

aiRead.keyFinding: iPSC细胞治疗神经退行性疾病的关键瓶颈在于移植后“黑箱”期，需从干细胞生物学转向移植生物学以优化疗效。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据，且对ALS的具体转化路径讨论相对有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对移植后“黑箱”期的工程化策略，如免疫调节、移植物组成优化及基因组完整性监测在ALS模型中的验证。

items.abstractZh: 在诱导多能干细胞发现二十年后，该领域已从患者特异性疾病建模迈向针对神经退行性疾病的细胞治疗。帕金森病已成为神经元替代治疗的主要模型，而亨廷顿病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化则需要回路重建、细胞支持、免疫调节和工程化治疗递送的不同组合。我们讨论了临床转化的关键决定因素，包括细胞来源、产品身份、移植物组成、移植物-宿主相互作用、生产可重复性、基因组完整性和临床评估。我们提出，细胞移植与长期植入之间的间隔构成了一个生物学“黑箱”，移植物命运和治疗结局在此间被决定。随着再生医学进入第三个十年，未来的进展不仅取决于生成治疗性细胞，还取决于阐明和工程化决定移植后命运的生物学过程，这标志着从干细胞生物学向移植生物学的概念转变。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，系统总结了iPSC在神经退行性疾病中二十年的转化经验，并提出了移植生物学这一新概念，对ALS细胞治疗策略的优化具有重要指导价值。

items.title: Acidic cannabinoids in brain disorders: Neurobiological mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and translational challenges.
items.summary: Acidic cannabinoids, including tetrahydrocannabinolic acid (THCA), cannabidiolic acid (CBDA), cannabigerolic acid (CBGA), and related biosynthetic precursors, represent the predominant phytocannabinoid forms naturally produced by Cannabis sativa. Long considered pharmacologically inactive intermediates, these compounds are now increasingly recognized as bioactive molecules with potential therapeutic relevance for brain disorders. Compared with their decarboxylated counterparts, acidic cannabinoids exhibit distinct physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamic properties that may confer reduced psychotropic liability together with unique neurobiological effects. Emerging preclinical evidence indicates that acidic cannabinoids modulate multiple processes implicated in neurological and psychiatric disorders, including serotonergic and endocannabinoid signaling, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, calcium dyshomeostasis, and synaptic transmission. In this review, we critically examine current knowledge regarding acidic cannabinoids in the context of brain disorders. We first summarize their biosynthesis, chemical stability, pharmacokinetic characteristics, and pharmacological differences from neutral cannabinoids. We then examine preclinical evidence supporting their potential therapeutic effects in epilepsy, anxiety, depression, psychosis-related conditions, and neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We also discuss how artificial intelligence and computational approaches may support target identification, formulation optimization, pharmacokinetic modeling, and the development of personalized cannabinoid-based interventions. Finally, we highlight key methodological and translational challenges limiting the field and outline priorities for future research. Overall, acidic cannabinoids emerge as promising but still underexplored multitarget compounds with potential relevance for the treatment of brain disorders.
items.titleZh: 酸性大麻素在大脑疾病中的作用：神经生物学机制、临床前证据与转化挑战
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了酸性大麻素（THCA、CBDA、CBGA等）在脑部疾病中的神经生物学机制与临床前证据。文章指出，这些曾被当作无活性中间体的化合物，可能通过调节内源性大麻素和5-羟色胺信号、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能、钙稳态和突触传递等多条通路发挥作用。综述覆盖癫痫、焦虑、抑郁、精神病相关状况以及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病。作者同时讨论了人工智能在靶点识别、制剂优化和药代动力学建模中的潜在应用，并强调该领域仍面临方法学和转化方面的挑战。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于将酸性大麻素明确纳入神经退行性疾病的多靶点干预框架，并特别提及ALS。其讨论的神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍和钙稳态失衡等机制，均与ALS已知的病理通路高度重叠。尽管目前仅有临床前证据，但酸性大麻素可能具有较低的精神活性风险，这使其在转化开发上具有一定吸引力。综述还提示人工智能可用于靶点识别和药代动力学建模，为未来从临床前向临床推进提供了方法学思路。

aiRead.keyFinding: 酸性大麻素（THCA、CBDA、CBGA等）是具有多靶点神经生物学活性的化合物，临床前证据提示其可能通过调节神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能和钙稳态等通路，对包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病产生潜在治疗相关性。
aiRead.limitation: 文章为综述，所依据的证据主要来自临床前研究，缺乏临床疗效验证；酸性大麻素在人体中的药代动力学、安全性和有效性尚不明确，且存在方法学和转化方面的挑战。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对酸性大麻素在ALS模型中的机制验证研究，以及是否推进至早期临床试验；同时关注人工智能在靶点识别和药代动力学建模中的实际应用进展。

items.abstractZh: 酸性大麻素，包括四氢大麻酚酸（THCA）、大麻二酚酸（CBDA）、大麻萜酚酸（CBGA）及相关生物合成前体，是Cannabis sativa天然产生的主要植物大麻素形式。这些化合物长期被视为药理上无活性的中间体，如今日益被认为是对脑部疾病具有潜在治疗相关性的生物活性分子。与其脱羧对应物相比，酸性大麻素表现出独特的理化、药代动力学和药效学特性，可能赋予其较低的精神活性风险以及独特的神经生物学效应。新兴的临床前证据表明，酸性大麻素可调节与神经和精神疾病相关的多个过程，包括5-羟色胺能和内源性大麻素信号传导、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、钙稳态失衡以及突触传递。在本综述中，我们批判性地审视了当前关于酸性大麻素在脑部疾病背景下的知识。我们首先总结其生物合成、化学稳定性、药代动力学特征以及与中性大麻素的药理学差异。随后，我们审视支持其在癫痫、焦虑、抑郁、精神病相关状况以及神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化）中潜在治疗效果的临床前证据。我们还讨论了人工智能和计算方法如何支持靶点识别、制剂优化、药代动力学建模以及个性化大麻素干预措施的开发。最后，我们强调了限制该领域的关键方法学和转化挑战，并概述了未来研究的优先事项。总体而言，酸性大麻素作为有前景但仍未被充分探索的多靶点化合物，对脑部疾病的治疗具有潜在相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近系统整合了酸性大麻素在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的临床前机制证据，并探讨了人工智能辅助的转化开发路径，对探索ALS多靶点干预策略具有参考价值。

items.title: Associations Between Prediagnosis Plasma Neurofilament Light Polypeptide and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Risk in the Danish EPIC Cohort.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with a rapid time from symptoms onset to diagnosis. Elevated neurofilament light polypeptide (NfL) is well-established in symptomatic ALS and up to 5 years prediagnosis, but earlier timeframes remain understudied. We aimed to assess plasma NfL levels up to 23 years before ALS diagnosis and the relation to ALS risk. We conducted a nested matched case-control study within the Danish EPIC cohort (baseline 1993-1997) including 166 ALS cases (diagnosed 1997-2017) and 332 controls matched on birth year and sex. Plasma samples collected 0.4 to 23.2 years (median 14.1 years) prediagnosis were analyzed for NfL using Olink Target 96. Odds ratios were estimated using conditional logistic regression. Discriminatory performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic curves. NfL levels were elevated in ALS cases relative to controls up to 14.6 years before diagnosis. Among those with blood samples collected <5, 5 to 14.6, and >14.6 years before diagnosis, the odds ratios (95% CI) for ALS per standard deviation increase in the normalized protein expression value of NfL were 3.8 (1.4-10.3), 1.7 (1.2-2.3), and 1.3 (0.9-1.7), respectively. The areas under the curve for ALS discrimination by NfL among those with blood collected <5 and 5-14.6 years before diagnosis were 0.78 and 0.63, respectively. Plasma NfL elevation may occur significantly earlier than previously reported, indicating a much longer ALS prodrome. Assuming other biomarker changes may also occur earlier, this raises the possibility of identifying at-risk individuals early that could benefit epidemiologic analyses, clinical trials, and prevention efforts. ANN NEUROL 2026.
items.evidenceLevel: 巢式病例对照研究（丹麦EPIC队列）
items.titleZh: 丹麦EPIC队列中诊断前血浆神经丝轻链多肽与肌萎缩侧索硬化风险之间的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项基于丹麦EPIC队列的巢式病例对照研究显示，ALS患者诊断前血浆NfL水平升高可追溯至诊断前约14.6年，远早于此前认为的5年窗口。诊断前5年内NfL的判别能力较强（AUC 0.78），5至14.6年间判别能力中等（AUC 0.63），而超过14.6年后关联不再显著。结果提示ALS前驱期可能长达十余年，为极早期识别高危人群提供了生物标志物线索。
items.insight: 该研究将ALS诊断前NfL可检测升高的时间窗从既往的5年大幅扩展至约14.6年，提示ALS前驱期远比既往认知更长。这对ALS研究者具有多重意义：一是重新定义了“高危期”的时间尺度，可能影响未来预防性试验的入组窗口和筛查策略设计；二是提示在诊断前十余年即存在可检测的神经轴索损伤，为研究疾病极早期机制提供了人群证据；三是AUC随距诊断时间延长而下降，说明NfL单独用于超早期筛查的判别能力有限，未来需探索多标志物组合策略。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，从症状出现到诊断的时间很短。神经丝轻链多肽（NfL）升高在症状性ALS及诊断前长达5年内已得到充分证实，但更早的时间窗仍研究不足。我们旨在评估ALS诊断前长达23年的血浆NfL水平及其与ALS风险的关系。我们在丹麦EPIC队列（基线1993-1997年）内开展了一项巢式匹配病例对照研究，纳入166例ALS病例（1997-2017年诊断）和332例按出生年份和性别匹配的对照。采用Olink Target 96分析诊断前0.4至23.2年（中位数14.1年）采集的血浆样本中的NfL。使用条件logistic回归估计比值比。采用受试者工作特征曲线评估判别性能。与对照相比，ALS病例的NfL水平在诊断前长达14.6年即已升高。在诊断前<5年、5至14.6年及>14.6年采集血样的受试者中，NfL归一化蛋白表达值每增加一个标准差对应的ALS比值比（95% CI）分别为3.8（1.4-10.3）、1.7（1.2-2.3）和1.3（0.9-1.7）。在诊断前<5年和5-14.6年采集血液的受试者中，NfL判别ALS的曲线下面积分别为0.78和0.63。血浆NfL升高可能显著早于既往报道，提示ALS前驱期远比已知更长。假设其他生物标志物变化也可能更早出现，这提高了早期识别高危个体的可能性，从而可能使流行病学分析、临床试验和预防工作受益。ANN NEUROL 2026。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于大型前瞻性队列，新近将ALS诊断前血浆NfL升高的可检测窗口扩展至约14.6年，对ALS极早期生物标志物筛查和预防性试验设计具有重要转化价值。

items.title: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: This article describes the nerve loss underlying amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, its clinical manifestations, examination findings leading to the diagnosis, the expanding role of genetics, and available treatment and patient management. The cause of neuron death in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is not known, but many genes are strongly linked to the disease, in both patients with a family history and those with no history. A multistep pathologic process helps to explain the onset of symptoms later in life, even in patients with associated genes. Posttranslational and epigenetic changes are also important factors. Current clinical trials are based on putative pathologic mechanisms, and some newer therapies are gene-based. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis has distinctive features and can be diagnosed largely from the history and examination, and true mimics are rare. While the cause of neuronal death is not known, pathogenic and risk factor gene variations are present in a number of patients, and posttranscriptional and epigenetic changes are likely major causative factors. Environmental factors likely contribute, but specific avoidable factors have not been identified. Drugs to slow the progress of the disease are currently limited, but trials for all patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis continue, including a focus on genetic factors. Patient management is optimized in multidisciplinary amyotrophic lateral sclerosis clinics, and interventions for nutrition with gastric feeding tubes and respiratory insufficiency by noninvasive ventilation enhance patient comfort.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化。
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇关于肌萎缩侧索硬化的综述，概述了神经元丢失、临床表现、诊断检查、遗传学作用以及治疗和患者管理。文章指出神经元死亡原因仍不明确，但许多基因与疾病密切相关，多步骤病理过程可解释晚发症状，翻译后和表观遗传改变也很重要。当前试验基于推测机制，部分新疗法为基因疗法。诊断主要依靠病史和检查，真正的模拟病罕见。减缓疾病进展的药物仍有限，但针对所有患者的试验持续进行，包括遗传因素方向。多学科门诊管理、胃饲管营养支持及无创通气可改善患者舒适度。
items.insight: 该综述强调ALS的遗传异质性、多步骤病理模型以及表观遗传/翻译后改变在发病中的作用，并指出当前试验仍基于推测机制、部分新疗法转向基因靶向。对ALS研究者而言，这有助于把握从基因发现到临床试验设计的转化逻辑，并提醒在缺乏明确可避免环境因素的情况下，多学科支持治疗仍是患者管理核心。

items.abstractZh: 本文描述了肌萎缩侧索硬化背后的神经丢失、其临床表现、导致诊断的检查发现、遗传学日益扩大的作用，以及可用的治疗和患者管理。肌萎缩侧索硬化患者神经元死亡的原因尚不清楚，但许多基因与该病密切相关，无论是在有家族史的患者中还是在无家族史的患者中。多步骤病理过程有助于解释症状在生命后期才出现，即使在携带相关基因的患者中也是如此。翻译后和表观遗传改变也是重要因素。当前临床试验基于推测的病理机制，一些较新的疗法是基于基因的。肌萎缩侧索硬化具有独特特征，主要可通过病史和检查作出诊断，真正的模拟病罕见。虽然神经元死亡的原因尚不清楚，但致病性和风险因素基因变异存在于部分患者中，转录后和表观遗传改变可能是主要致病因素。环境因素可能起作用，但尚未确定具体的可避免因素。目前减缓疾病进展的药物有限，但针对所有肌萎缩侧索硬化患者的试验仍在继续，包括对遗传因素的关注。在多学科肌萎缩侧索硬化门诊中患者管理得到优化，通过胃饲管进行营养干预以及通过无创通气处理呼吸功能不全可提高患者舒适度。

items.title: Insertion or deletion variants in TAF15 exon 15 are genetic factors impacting the prognosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in a Japanese cohort.
items.summary: The influence of genetic factors on the prognosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) has attracted considerable attention, with numerous studies exploring this relationship in clinically diagnosed patients. The present study attempted to clarify the precise impact of genetic factors on prognosis in patients with pathologically confirmed sporadic ALS. We conducted exome analysis on 137 consecutively autopsied patients with sporadic ALS exhibiting TDP-43 pathology, screening for non-synonymous or splice-site rare variants (RVs) in ALS-related genes. The impact of these variants on ALS prognosis was subsequently assessed. The exome analysis identified 31 RVs in 27 of the 137 patients, including TAF15 exon 15 insertion/deletion mutations (TAF15-15 indels) in 9 patients. Patients harboring RVs had significantly shorter survival times (median 18.0 months) than those without RVs (28.5 months), as determined by log-rank test (p = 0.02). Notably, the 9 cases with TAF15-15 indels demonstrated a significantly poorer outcome (15.0 months, p = 3e-06). Lattice Simulation of Sticker-Spacer Interactions (LASSI) simulations revealed stronger negative sticker-sticker interactions, and a tendency toward lower saturation concentration and higher dense-phase concentration in TAF15-15 indel proteins, suggesting enhanced condensation. The present analysis of pathologically diagnosed ALS patients has yielded genetic factors that could potentially aid more accurate diagnosis and prognostication. The frequent identification of TAF15-15 indels among ALS cases, and their association with significantly poorer outcome, suggests that this type of mutation could be prognostically significant in ALS. Furthermore, the mechanism by which TAF15-15 indels influence the course of ALS could be a promising target for future treatments.
items.titleZh: TAF15第15号外显子插入或缺失变异是影响日本队列肌萎缩侧索硬化预后的遗传因素
items.summaryZh: 这项研究对137例经尸检病理确诊的散发性ALS患者进行了外显子组分析，发现携带罕见变异的患者生存期更短。其中，9例携带TAF15第15号外显子插入/缺失突变的患者预后显著更差，中位生存期仅15.0个月。计算模拟提示该突变可能增强TAF15蛋白的凝聚倾向。研究提示TAF15-15 indels可能作为ALS预后标志物，并可能成为治疗靶点。

items.abstractZh: 遗传因素对肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）预后的影响已引起广泛关注，众多研究在临床诊断患者中探索了这一关系。本研究试图阐明遗传因素对经病理确诊的散发性ALS患者预后的确切影响。我们对137例连续尸检的、具有TDP-43病理表现的散发性ALS患者进行了外显子组分析，筛查ALS相关基因中的非同义或剪接位点罕见变异（RVs）。随后评估了这些变异对ALS预后的影响。外显子组分析在137例患者中的27例中鉴定出31个RVs，包括9例患者中的TAF15第15号外显子插入/缺失突变（TAF15-15 indels）。携带RVs的患者生存时间显著短于无RVs的患者（中位18.0个月 vs 28.5个月），log-rank检验p=0.02。值得注意的是，9例携带TAF15-15 indels的病例表现出显著更差的结局（15.0个月，p=3e-06）。贴纸-间隔区相互作用的晶格模拟（LASSI）显示，TAF15-15 indel蛋白具有更强的负性贴纸-贴纸相互作用，并倾向于更低的饱和浓度和更高的浓相浓度，提示凝聚增强。本项对病理确诊ALS患者的分析发现了可能有助于更准确诊断和预后判断的遗传因素。TAF15-15 indels在ALS病例中的频繁检出及其与显著更差结局的关联，提示此类突变可能具有预后意义。此外，TAF15-15 indels影响ALS病程的机制可能成为未来治疗的有前景的靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 新近研究在病理确诊的ALS队列中首次将TAF15-15 indels与显著更差的预后关联，并提示蛋白凝聚增强机制，具有预后标志物和转化治疗价值。

items.title: Progressive anterior opercular syndrome (Foix-Chavany-Marie syndrome) in neurodegenerative disease: a case series.
items.summary: Anterior opercular syndrome (Foix-Chavany-Marie syndrome) is characterized by severe dysarthria, impaired voluntary orofacial and pharyngolingual movements, and preserved automatic or emotional movements (automatic-voluntary dissociation). Although classically associated with stroke, its progressive neurodegenerative form is rare and poorly understood. We report two patients to characterize its clinical and neuroanatomical features. The cases were identified retrospectively through review of clinical and neuroimaging records from behavioral neurology centers in the United States and Japan. Both had severe dysarthria and oral-phase dysphagia. Voluntary orofacial movements were markedly impaired, whereas reflexive movements, including coughing and yawning, and emotional movements, including smiling in response to humor, were preserved. Coordination, posture, and gait were initially preserved. Both patients showed predominantly upper motor neuron features without lower motor neuron signs; limb and cranial electromyography was normal in the patient tested. Neuroimaging showed bilateral frontal atrophy and hypometabolism or hypoperfusion involving the anterior operculum. These findings suggest that progressive anterior opercular syndrome may emerge when bilateral opercular regions are affected by neurodegeneration. Recognition of this syndrome may facilitate anticipatory management of dysarthria, dysphagia, and nutritional risk and broaden awareness of speech and orofacial motor syndromes in frontotemporal dementia and related phenotypes.

items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中的进行性前岛盖综合征（Foix-Chavany-Marie综合征）：病例系列
items.summaryZh: 这项病例系列报告了两例神经退行性疾病患者出现进行性前岛盖综合征（Foix-Chavany-Marie综合征），表现为严重构音障碍、自主口面部运动受损而反射性和情绪性运动保留，影像学显示双侧前岛盖区域萎缩和代谢/灌注减低。研究提示该综合征可由神经退行性变引起，而非仅见于卒中，识别它有助于早期管理构音障碍、吞咽困难和营养风险。

items.abstractZh: 前岛盖综合征（Foix-Chavany-Marie综合征）以严重构音障碍、自主口面部及咽舌运动受损、而自动性或情绪性运动保留（自动-自主分离）为特征。尽管该综合征经典上与卒中相关，但其进行性神经退行性变形式罕见且认识不足。我们报告两例患者以描述其临床和神经解剖学特征。病例通过回顾美国及日本行为神经病学中心的临床和神经影像记录进行回顾性识别。两例患者均有严重构音障碍和口腔期吞咽困难。自主口面部运动显著受损，而反射性运动（包括咳嗽和打哈欠）及情绪性运动（包括对幽默的微笑反应）保留。协调、姿势和步态最初保留。两例患者均表现为以上运动神经元特征为主，无下运动神经元体征；接受检测的一例患者肢体和颅神经肌电图正常。神经影像显示双侧额叶萎缩及涉及前岛盖的低代谢或低灌注。这些发现提示，当双侧岛盖区域受到神经退行性变影响时，可能出现进行性前岛盖综合征。识别该综合征可能有助于对构音障碍、吞咽困难和营养风险进行预期管理，并拓宽对额颞叶痴呆及相关表型中言语和口面部运动综合征的认识。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近描述了神经退行性疾病中罕见的进行性前岛盖综合征，拓展了ALS/额颞叶痴呆谱系中延髓和口面部运动障碍的表型认识，具有临床识别和转化管理价值。

items.title: A genetic screen for suppressors of neuron degeneration in a C. elegans sod-1G85R model of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Genetic variants in superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) cause the progressive neurodegenerative disease Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). Treatments for this disease are limited, and the unique vulnerability of cholinergic and glutamatergic motor neurons to degeneration seen in ALS patients is not clearly understood. Identifying genetic modifiers of neurodegeneration can provide insight into the selective vulnerability of motor neurons in ALS and may accelerate identification of novel therapeutic targets. Here, we describe a forward genetic screen for suppressors of the stress-induced glutamatergic neuron degeneration in a single-copy C. elegans model of sod-1G85R. Used two different screening strategies, we identified 53 suppressor lines that decreased glutamatergic neuron degeneration to varying degrees. To rapidly identify suppressor genes, we sequenced suppressor lines and identified candidate suppressor genes based on frequency of de novo exonic mutations and previously published work. Two candidates were tested and excluded as suppressor genes: erh-1 and imph-1. For a subset of unidentified suppressor lines, we determined if cholinergic neurodegeneration was also suppressed; roughly one-third of suppressor lines showed no corresponding cholinergic neuron rescue, suggesting that mechanisms involved in cholinergic and glutamatergic degeneration are at least partially divergent. This study outlines the first unbiased genetic screen in a knock-in model of SOD1 neurodegeneration, describes a cohort of candidate suppressor lines with decreased SOD1-dependent neurodegeneration, excludes two candidates and discusses approaches for suppressor mutation isolation and gene identification.

items.abstractZh: 超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD1）的遗传变异导致进行性神经退行性疾病肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）。该疾病的治疗手段有限，且ALS患者中胆碱能和谷氨酸能运动神经元对变性的独特易感性尚不明确。鉴定神经退行性变的遗传修饰因子有助于理解ALS中运动神经元的选择性易感性，并可能加速新型治疗靶点的发现。在此，我们描述了一项在单拷贝秀丽隐杆线虫sod-1G85R模型中对应激诱导的谷氨酸能神经元变性抑制因子的正向遗传筛选。采用两种不同的筛选策略，我们鉴定出53个抑制因子品系，这些品系不同程度地减轻了谷氨酸能神经元变性。为快速鉴定抑制基因，我们对抑制因子品系进行了测序，并基于新发外显子突变频率和既往发表的工作鉴定候选抑制基因。两个候选基因经测试被排除为抑制基因：erh-1和imph-1。对于一部分未鉴定的抑制因子品系，我们确定胆碱能神经退行性变是否也被抑制；约三分之一的抑制因子品系未显示相应的胆碱能神经元挽救，提示胆碱能和谷氨酸能变性所涉及的机制至少部分不同。本研究概述了在SOD1神经退行性变敲入模型中的首个无偏遗传筛选，描述了一组减轻SOD1依赖性神经退行性变的候选抑制因子品系，排除了两个候选基因，并讨论了抑制突变分离和基因鉴定的方法。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究在SOD1 ALS敲入线虫模型中完成首个无偏遗传筛选，为解析运动神经元选择性易感性和发现新治疗靶点提供了新近的遗传学资源。

items.title: Near-optimal P300 speller performance using large language models: A multi-model analysis with performance bounds.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a progressive neurodegenerative disease, severely impairs communication, requiring assistive technologies that restore interaction. The P300 speller brain-computer interface (BCI) enables communication by translating EEG responses into text; however, its practical adoption is limited by slow typing speed and the need for subject-specific calibration. Recent work has demonstrated that large language models (LLMs), such as GPT-2, can significantly improve the performance of the P300 speller by predicting words. However, it remains unclear whether these gains are model-specific or represent a broader trend across language models. Furthermore, the framework-specific performance bounds of LLM-assisted P300 spellers have not been systematically characterized within a unified decoding framework. In this study, we address these gaps through a systematic multi-model theoretical analysis framework. We evaluate a wide range of language models and introduce an idealized LLM to establish upper bounds on achievable performance. In addition, we incorporate cross-subject classifier training to reduce calibration requirements and assess generalization across subjects. Using extensive simulations on EEG data from 78 subjects, we demonstrate that the evaluated models consistently achieve substantial improvements in typing speed, with gains of up to ~45% (within-subject training) and ~75% (across-subject training) over conventional approaches. More importantly, we show that several high-performing models, despite architectural differences, operate within 5% of the theoretical performance bound, indicating diminishing returns from further model scaling. These improvements generalize across both within-subject and across-subject classifiers. Our results suggest that LLM-assisted P300 spellers are approaching oracle-based upper bounds within the considered decoding framework, shifting the primary bottleneck from language modeling to neural signal decoding.
